documents.title: Event API contract
documents.text:
# Event API contract

POST /v2/events requires an Idempotency-Key header. A repeated key with a different payload returns HTTP 409. Keys expire after 48 hours.

## Retrying
A HTTP 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds. Retry temporary HTTP 503 errors with exponential backoff. Permanent HTTP 422 validation errors must be corrected before retry.

## Access
Only workspace owners may rotate API credentials. Event readers may list authorized events.

documents.title: Architecture decision 14
documents.text: Architecture decision 14, accepted 2026-06-10. PostgreSQL stores events and a transactional outbox in the same transaction. An outbox dispatcher publishes to the delivery service. The choice prevents committed events from being lost between database commit and delivery. An expired dispatcher lease allows another worker to resume. The API process does not publish directly.

documents.title: Travel approval policy
documents.text:
# Travel approval policy

Domestic travel under EUR 800 requires the department lead's approval. International travel or expenses of EUR 800 and above require Finance approval before booking. Submit expense receipts within 14 calendar days of return. Personal meals are excluded from reimbursement.

documents.title: Incident escalation procedure
documents.text: Incident escalation procedure. Severity 1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes by the duty engineer. The incident commander sends stakeholder updates every 30 minutes. Severity 2 incidents are acknowledged within 2 business hours. Close an incident only after the owner records a recovery check and follow-up actions.
